intro.title: Engineered services for concrete, steel and piping.
intro.body: Seema General Contracting & Industrial Services Co. specializes in structural rehabilitation — maintenance and support of concrete and steel structures and the repair of process piping, using advanced carbon fiber composites and epoxy coatings for extreme corrosive environments.

home.servicesSubtitle: Six disciplines, one specialised team — covering inspection, repair, reinforcement and protection.
home.projectsTitle: Trusted across the Kingdom's heaviest industries.
home.ctaTitle: Have a structure that needs rehabilitation?
home.ctaBody: Send us the scope. We'll come back with an engineered approach, a timeline and a fixed-fee proposal.

values.missionBody: Introduce specialized engineered services and solutions, and build a specialised maintenance team in the rehabilitation field.
values.goalBody: Team up with international partners to bring specialised engineered services and well-trained personnel that establish localised support for the industrial sector.
values.visionBody: Collaborate with international and local companies in civil engineering, structural maintenance and civil construction to raise the bar of what is possible locally.

services.metaDesc: Carbon fiber reinforcement, concrete and steel repair, process piping rehabilitation, epoxy coatings and structural inspection.
services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Specialised engineering for the structures that keep industry running.

carbon.title: Carbon Fiber Reinforcement
carbon.body: Advanced FRP wrapping and laminate systems that restore and increase the structural capacity of concrete columns, beams and slabs — without adding meaningful weight.

concrete.title: Concrete Repair
concrete.body: Crack injection, structural grouting, spall repair and surface restoration using high-performance polymer-modified mortars and resins.

steel.title: Steel Rehabilitation
steel.body: Section replacement, plate bonding, weld repair and corrosion mitigation for industrial frames, racks, jetties and bridges.

piping.title: Process Piping Repair
piping.body: In-service composite repairs and engineered clamps for leaking, corroded or mechanically damaged process lines.

epoxy.title: Epoxy & Protective Coatings
epoxy.body: Chemical-resistant coatings and linings engineered for extreme corrosive environments — tanks, secondary containment, refinery floors.

inspection.title: Inspection & Assessment
inspection.body: Non-destructive testing, condition surveys and structural assessments that translate into a defensible rehabilitation plan.

about.metaDesc: Seema is a Saudi specialist in structural rehabilitation — partnering with international firms to bring engineered solutions to local industry.
about.title: A specialist contractor for what cannot fail.
about.lead: We exist to extend the working life of the assets that power the Kingdom — refineries, power plants, pipelines, jetties, bridges. Our team combines local execution with international engineering practice.

projects.metaDesc: Selected rehabilitation, reinforcement and protective coating projects delivered by Seema across Saudi Arabia.
projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A snapshot of work delivered for refineries, utilities and infrastructure clients.

p1.title: Cooling Tower Rehabilitation
p1.body: Full external rehabilitation of a hyperbolic concrete cooling tower — including crack injection, surface restoration and protective coating.

p2.title: Pipeline Protective Coating
p2.body: Application of corrosion-grade epoxy systems across kilometres of above-ground process pipeline.

p3.title: Bridge Pier Carbon Fiber Wrap
p3.body: FRP confinement on bridge piers to restore seismic capacity without interrupting traffic.

p4.title: Refinery Tank Lining
p4.body: Chemical-resistant lining of secondary containment and process tanks.
